journal_lines: Skeleton archer in the dark. Kept moving.
Rattling thing in the path. Dealt with it.
Three arrows stuck in the dirt. None in me.
An archer in the dark, still as the stone behind it. The stillness did not save it.
The arrow passed where my shoulder had been. Where my shoulder no longer was.
Twelve arrows in the wall behind me. I counted them later. The wall did not.
It clattered down like a poorly stacked thing. A pile of someone, once.
Older than the cave it haunted. Older than the one before that.
A noise like dice rolling in a wooden cup, and then no noise at all.
The skull kept its grin. They keep it through everything, in the end.
Felled it the way a small tree is felled. Same work. Less ceremony.
